pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal, dark brown contiguous regions with smooth-gradient edges. Spatial area is larger and more quadrangular on the shoulder/flank, transitioning to smaller, more elongated shapes on the upper neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous grid of light-colored pathways with uniform pixel thickness. Nodes predominantly feature three-way and four-way intersections forming a regular topological lattice across the flank.
